evidence.reason: The alleged defect is already remedied at the pinned tip: `executeMerges` reads `maxRetries` at line 179 and immediately validates it with `Number.isSafeInteger(maxRetries) || maxRetries < 0`, throwing a `RangeError` otherwise (lines 180-184). This is functionally equivalent to the proposed fix (only the intermediate `requested` variable differs), so direct TS callers passing `NaN`/`Infinity`/negative values are now rejected instead of causing an unbounded retry loop. The provided history explicitly lists commit e21aa6e100e4ffba35b02852c7d24ffbb9017a9d as tightening the `maxRetries` guard, which is the fixing change.
